Digital Master Data ID

The identifier of a requirement represented by a UUID, valid for the Catena-X dataspace.
Name
digitalMasterDataID
Characteristic
Trait
Referenz
  • https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4122
Typ http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Beispiel
urn:uuid:48878d48-6f1d-47f5-8ded-a441d0d879df
Optional
Nein
Im Payload
Ja
Payload Schlüssel
digitalMasterDataID
Bedingungen
  • UUID v4 Regular Expression
    Beschreibung
    The provided regular expression ensures that the UUID is composed of five groups of characters separated by hyphens, in the form 8-4-4-4-12 for a total of 36 characters (32 hexadecimal characters and 4 hyphens), optionally prefixed by "urn:uuid:" to make it an IRI.
    Referenz
    • https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122
    Regulärer Ausdruck
    (^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)|(^urn:uuid:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)

Version Entity

Entity for requirement version

Properties

Version Number

Semantic version of the requirement
Name
versionNumber
Characteristic
Trait
Referenz
Typ http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Beispiel
2.0.0
Optional
Nein
Im Payload
Ja
Payload Schlüssel
versionNumber
Referenz
  • https://semver.org/
Bedingungen
  • Version Regular Expression
    Beschreibung
    Version number in semantic versioning
    Regulärer Ausdruck
    ^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?(?:\+([0-9a-zA-Z-]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*))?$
Version Id

The identifier of this exact version of the requirement represented by a UUID, valid for the Catena-X dataspace.
Name
versionId
Characteristic
Trait
Referenz
  • https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc4122
Typ http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string
Optional
Nein
Im Payload
Ja
Payload Schlüssel
versionId
Bedingungen
  • UUID v4 Regular Expression
    Beschreibung
    The provided regular expression ensures that the UUID is composed of five groups of characters separated by hyphens, in the form 8-4-4-4-12 for a total of 36 characters (32 hexadecimal characters and 4 hyphens), optionally prefixed by "urn:uuid:" to make it an IRI.
    Referenz
    • https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc4122
    Regulärer Ausdruck
    (^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)|(^urn:uuid:[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$)
